name: How long does it take to complete a kitchen addition project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a kitchen addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen addition project generally spans 4 to 8 months from initial design to final completion. This includes several phases: 4-8 weeks for design and architectural planning, 2-4 weeks for permitting approval, and then 3-6 months for construction. Factors such as the project's complexity, material lead times, inspection schedules, and any unforeseen structural issues can influence the overall duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen addition project typically takes 4 to 8 months, covering design, permitting, and construction phases.
